study.question: Does the observed benefit of factorized feedback channels require slot-local content x feedback products, rather than a second learned content projection or generic feedback scaling, and can this interaction be computed after eight-slot compression at lower measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed: target grouping beat positional grouping at both early and late scoring; uniform_summary beat learned scoring, while counts_only and no_history were substantially worse. In round2 factorized macro AUC0.8266994488 exceeded joint0.8263530773, composition0.8239389521 and widened parent0.8235637030. The joint-pairing prediction was not supported in this single seed. Factorized versus composition confounds multiplicative interaction with an additional learned item projection. Hypothesis: a useful inductive bias is the explicit product of a target-routed slot mean and its feedback rate; fine within-slot feedback association is not required for this implementation. A bias-free linear projection commutes with fixed mean pooling in real arithmetic, so the same feature map can be formed from eight means without projecting100 events or constructing unused joint moments. This is a local mechanism and implementation hypothesis, not an originality claim or a refutation of all association-preserving models. All13 authorized execution receipts are successful and previous_runtime_error is null: the unsupported joint-pairing prediction is scientific counterevidence, not an execution failure. Raw parquet and Torch are not available in this coding context; accepted host baseline/data identities are inherited and a fresh empirical baseline cannot be rerun here.

study.proposed_difference: Main candidate computes z_s=W(mean_s x) once for each of eight target/recency slots, and m_st=z_s*f_st, rather than mean_s(Wx)*f_st plus unconsumed joint statistics. All three pooled variants share this implementation and identical registered capacity. Replace f_st by1 (content-only) or global user-history feedback fraction g_t to test product necessity and localization. Explicit f_st, counts, context and content paths remain present in every pooled variant. legacy_local is an exact source/config bridge. This is an attribution/efficiency follow-up to the strongest existing control, with no verified novelty claim.
predictions: If explicit local products are useful, pooled_local will exceed pooled_content in macro AUC under the same paired recipe; report every task delta even where negative. A gain alone is preliminary and requires paired repetition before mechanism support.

If localization matters beyond generic feedback scaling, pooled_local will exceed pooled_global while both retain identical local fractions as separate inputs. Equality or reversal would weaken the localization explanation.

With the same state_dict and eval batch, pooled_local and legacy_local should agree in FP32 to rtol1e-5/atol1e-6 for probabilities and rtol1e-4/atol1e-6 for dense gradients; separately measure BF16 max/mean error. FP32 failures block the cost-equivalence interpretation. BF16 may induce divergent single-pass optimization; do not call the rewrite bitwise identical.

The feedback projection changes from100 item vectors to8 slot vectors (12.5x fewer vectors only for that linear operator at fixed padding length), and unused32-feedback-channel joint aggregation disappears. Measure total training/inference time, median/p95 batch latency, peak GPU bytes and parameters; no whole-model speedup is assumed.

Existing history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 are exploratory diagnostics. Preserve sample and positive/negative counts; do not infer a mechanism from cross-bin AUC differences. Empty histories produce zero compressed content/counts/feedback features in all variants.

Host preflight, charged to the same ledger: instantiate every module with the real feature map; verify identical state_dict keys/shapes and parameter counts; finite four[B,1] probabilities and BCE gradients; empty histories; one event; all100 events; no positive feedback; overlapping feedback masks; zero/unknown category or brand; in-vocabulary masked-payload and masked-feedback perturbation invariance; ignore target action. Compare legacy and pooled_local after loading identical weights in eval mode, with TF32 disabled; check FP32 gradients on the same fixed-label diagnostic batch, then measure BF16 error separately. No scoring or training was performed locally.
falsifiers: pooled_content matching or beating pooled_local across paired seeds weakens the explicit-product account; added projection or optimization would remain sufficient explanations.
pooled_global matching or beating pooled_local across paired seeds weakens the need to align feedback rates with target/recency slots.
No measured whole-model cost reduction, or material loss of validation quality in repeated paired comparisons, defeats the practical efficiency claim even if the linear algebra is equivalent.
Failure of masking, empty-history, source identity, finite-gradient or FP32 equivalence checks invalidates the affected comparison; record the failed cost and repair within the original budget.
A single seed or existing joint-factorized reversal cannot establish superiority or disprove within-slot pairing as a general mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Extra learned content projection and wider readout capacity, rather than multiplication, explain the round2 gain; content-only replacement directly checks this.
Feedback fraction is a generic propensity gate rather than a target-local interaction; global replacement checks this while retaining explicit local fractions.

Different feature magnitudes/gradient conditioning explain gating contrasts. Global and content replacements alter scale as part of the intervention; equal parameters do not remove this confound. Do not attribute a gain specifically to semantic routing without further controls.
BF16 reassociation, reduction order and seed-dependent training change quality after a mathematically equivalent rewrite; use shared-state FP32/BF16 checks plus paired repetitions.

The content control repeats four identical vectors and has lower effective rank despite matching registered parameters; interpret it as testing added projected content, not an exactly equal function-class control.

Prior source/config changes yielded uniform_summary0.8225477996 versus widened feedback_parent0.8235637030; architectural initialization/capacity effects remain. Use current exact legacy bridge instead of crediting all change to new feedback information.

variants.name: pooled_local
variants.note: Project eight pooled item-field means, then multiply by four slot-local feedback fractions. Remove unconsumed joint moments and event projection. Mathematically the incumbent feature map in exact arithmetic; BF16 equivalence and measured speed remain unverified.

variants.name: pooled_content
variants.note: Replace each feedback product by the same projected slot content, repeated into four task channels. Retain local fractions, counts, registered parameters and all tower columns. Isolates explicit multiplication from extra content projection capacity; repeated coordinates reduce effective channel diversity.

variants.name: pooled_global
variants.note: Multiply projected slot content by the per-user feedback fractions over all100 visible valid events, broadcast to each occupied slot. Keep the original slot-local fractions as explicit readout inputs. Tests whether local alignment in the product matters beyond generic feedback scaling.

variants.name: legacy_local
variants.note: Byte-identical source/config to g2-r0002-feedback_factorized; retain original event projection and unused joint computations. Current-run numerical/performance/cost bridge for the pooling rewrite; no novelty claim.
